# Block `timeline`

**Use:** Events or stages in time order, each with a label (date or stage) and a short text.

**Avoid:** Things that are not ordered in time.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "timeline",
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "1970",
      "title": "Relational model",
      "md": "Codd publishes the relational model."
    },
    {
      "label": "1974",
      "title": "SQL",
      "md": "SEQUEL, later SQL, is designed at IBM."
    }
  ],
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"timeline"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `items` | array of object | yes |
| `items[].label` | string | yes |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |
| `items[].md` | string | yes |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
